title: Drowning Love
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Natsume, a mature sixth-grade model from Tokyo, moves with her family to the countryside and meets the boy Kou, awakening intense feelings (MU/INKR description). Kodansha describes 'a turbulent tale of preteens on the brink of self-destruction' whose feelings swing between love and hatred; Natsume throws herself into modeling and the two later date (Kodansha blurbs). A 17-volume shoujo coming-of-age drama rated 16+ by Kodansha, adapted to a live-action film.
life_message: First love can be overwhelming and destructive; growing up means surviving it and finding your own path.

content.note: 'They fight one another' (Kodansha blurb); MU Violence, Delinquents, Gangs, Abuse.
